hero.title: Where the Brazilian entrepreneur grows in good company
hero.tagline: Connect people. Grow businesses. Create opportunities. Transform lives.
hero.intro: Building a business far from home doesn't have to be lonely. BBN brings together Brazilian entrepreneurs who trade contacts, learn side by side and open doors for one another — in Portuguese, among people who understand your road.

carousel.label: Photos from the BBN Gathering — March 2026

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.title: Ideas become businesses. Businesses become opportunities.
purpose.body: We exist to connect, train and boost Brazilian entrepreneurs: turning ideas into businesses, businesses into opportunities and opportunities into impact. Every gathering serves that movement — nothing on our calendar is there by accident.
purpose.vision: To build the largest and most relevant network of Brazilian entrepreneurs.

movements.label: What we do
movements.title: Five movements, one road
movements.intro: From the first handshake to the impact left in the community, BBN walks with the entrepreneur across five fronts that hold each other up.

pillars.label: How it works

pillars.intro: Events that bring everyone together, meetings that keep the bond alive and trainings that deepen the practice. Each pillar has two leaders in charge.

photos.intro: Full rooms, conversations that turn into business and people who arrived alone and left with partners. See what our gatherings look like.

hero.label: About BBN
hero.title: A network built on people
hero.intro: The Brazilian Business Network started from a simple conviction: a Brazilian entrepreneur in good company goes further. We are a community of business owners who meet, learn and recommend each other — on purpose, in Portuguese and without false competition.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.title: Connect, train and boost
purpose.body: We connect Brazilian entrepreneurs, train them with practical content and boost those ready for the next step. The goal never changes: turning ideas into businesses, businesses into opportunities and opportunities into real impact on people's lives.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: The largest and most relevant network of Brazilian entrepreneurs
vision.body: Relevant before large. We want to be the network a Brazilian entrepreneur turns to when they need a partner they can trust, an honest referral or someone who has already solved the problem in front of them today.

belief.label: What we believe
belief.quote: We don't just build businesses. We build people who build businesses.

whole.label: Whole-person development
whole.title: The whole entrepreneur
whole.intro: Nobody separates life from business. That's why we look at five dimensions of the entrepreneur — when one of them falls behind, the business feels it.

mente.title: Mind
mente.body: Clarity to decide and discipline to keep learning. We cultivate reading, mentoring and honest discussion about wins and mistakes.

corpo.title: Body
corpo.body: Energy is a working asset. Sleep, movement and food sustain the routine of someone carrying a business on their back.

espirito.title: Spirit
espirito.body: Purpose and principles before profit. We care for the inner life that holds up hard decisions and keeps character in place.

relacionamentos.title: Relationships
relacionamentos.body: Family, partners, team and clients. A healthy business rarely survives worn-out relationships — here we say that out loud.

negocios.title: Business
negocios.body: Management, sales, finance and growth. The daily practice, worked through with people who have faced the same challenge.

culture.label: Culture
culture.title: How we behave inside the network
culture.intro: Culture isn't a poster on the wall. These are six behaviors you'll recognize in the first meeting you attend.

contribuicao.title: Contribution first
contribuicao.body: Whoever arrives asking how they can help leaves with more than whoever arrives selling. Give before you ask — that's the BBN way.

relacionamento.title: Relationship before business
relacionamento.body: Trust first, proposal second. A referral only counts when you'd put your own name next to it.

crescimento.title: Constant growth
crescimento.body: Nobody arrives finished. Every event, meeting and training exists so you leave different from how you came in.

oportunidades.title: Mutual opportunities
oportunidades.body: One person's win opens the road for the next. We share clients, suppliers, contacts and lessons without holding anything back.

voluntariado.title: Volunteering
voluntariado.body: The network works because ordinary people give their time. Serving as a volunteer is the natural first step for anyone who wants to grow here.

intencionalidade.title: Intentionality
intencionalidade.body: No gathering without a goal. Every agenda, invitation and conversation has a clear reason and a defined next step.

conectar.title: Connect
conectar.body: We bring together Brazilian entrepreneurs who would hardly have met otherwise. Connection with a name, a face and context — not a contact list.

capacitar.title: Train
capacitar.body: Trainings and practical content on management, sales and finance, led by people who have applied it in their own business.

impulsionar.title: Boost
impulsionar.body: Anyone with an idea ready to go finds the push that was missing: partners, referrals and people willing to open the first door.

desenvolver.title: Grow
desenvolver.body: Growth with consistency, not by luck. We walk alongside the business all year, meeting after meeting.

impacto.title: Create impact
impacto.body: A strong business creates jobs, supports families and strengthens the Brazilian community around it. That's where the whole journey lands.

eventos.title: Events
eventos.frequency: Twice a year — March and September
eventos.body: Two major gatherings a year bring the whole network together: content, connections and the moment newcomers get to know BBN up close.

reunioes.title: Meetings
reunioes.body: Every month the network sits down together, in Portuguese, to present businesses, trade referrals and solve real problems in open discussion.

treinamentos.title: Trainings
treinamentos.body: Four times a year, member-only training sessions: deep, practical content you can apply the following week.

hero.label: How it works
hero.title: A simple, steady calendar
hero.intro: BBN is organized around three pillars, each with two leaders in charge. Together they keep the network active all year: events that gather everyone, meetings that bring people closer and trainings that go deeper.

visit.label: Visit a meeting
visit.title: Take a seat at the table as a guest
visit.intro: The easiest way to understand BBN is to attend a monthly meeting. Fill out the form and the leadership will get in touch with the details of the next meeting.
visit.guestRule: Guests may attend up to two monthly meetings before becoming members, and meetings are held in Portuguese.

outro.title: Ready to take a seat at the table?
outro.body: Guests may attend up to two meetings before becoming members — enough time to get to know the network and decide without pressure. After that, it's time to join.

hero.label: Membership
hero.title: Join the network
hero.intro: Being a BBN member means having a group of Brazilian entrepreneurs committed to your growth all year long: monthly meetings, member-only trainings, partnerships and the chance to move from member to leader.

price.label: Investment
price.note: Membership is subject to review and approval. Sending an application costs nothing: we talk first.

approval.label: Process
approval.title: How approval works
approval.intro: We approve based on shared values, not revenue. Four simple steps, no red tape.

candidatura.title: Application
candidatura.body: You fill out the form telling us who you are, what you do and what you expect from the network. It takes a few minutes.

conversa.title: Conversation
conversa.body: A BBN leader reaches out for an open talk about your business, your expectations and the way the network works.

analise.title: Review
analise.body: The leadership assesses whether there is room and alignment of values. Either way, you get a clear answer.

boasVindas.title: Welcome
boasVindas.body: Once approved, you're introduced to the network, added to the members group and expected at the next monthly meeting.

journey.label: Journey
journey.title: From guest to leader
journey.intro: Nobody has to arrive finished. This is the road most members travel inside BBN.

journeySteps.evento: You attend an event and feel the spirit of the network.
journeySteps.conhece: You get to know BBN: purpose, pillars and the people behind it.
journeySteps.membro: You become a member after the application and the talk with the leadership.
journeySteps.reunioes: You join the monthly meetings and start being known by name.
journeySteps.treinamentos: You take part in the quarterly trainings, exclusive to members.
journeySteps.parceiros: You access partners and opportunities inside and outside your state.
journeySteps.desenvolve: You grow the business with steady support from people who have been there.
journeySteps.contribui: You start contributing: referring, teaching and opening doors for others.
journeySteps.lidera: You serve as a volunteer and take the lead on one front of the network.

guidelines.label: Guidelines
guidelines.title: Community agreements
guidelines.intro: Five agreements keep the room safe and the focus in the right place. Every member knows them and upholds them.

semPolitica.title: No politics
semPolitica.body: There is no room for party politics at our gatherings. The focus is business, development and relationships.

principiosCristaos.title: Christian principles, non-denominational
principiosCristaos.body: Our values are rooted in Christian principles and the network is tied to no denomination. Everyone is welcome, with mutual respect.

portugues.title: Meetings in Portuguese
portugues.body: Meetings are held in Portuguese so everyone can speak naturally and nobody is left out of the conversation.

convidados.title: Guests: up to two meetings
convidados.body: Anyone who isn't a member yet may attend up to two meetings. After that, it's time to become a member to keep going.

treinamentosMembros.title: Trainings for members only
treinamentosMembros.body: The quarterly trainings are exclusive to members — it's the most direct benefit of membership.

valor.a: US$ 150 per person per year. It covers taking part in the monthly meetings and access to the quarterly trainings reserved for members.

quemPode.q: Who can become a BBN member?
quemPode.a: Brazilian entrepreneurs who already run a business or are getting one off the ground and want to grow by contributing to others. Commitment counts more than company size.

aprovacao.q: Why does membership go through approval?
aprovacao.a: Because the strength of the network lies in trust between people. The conversation with the leadership makes sure values line up before anyone joins.

convidado.a: Yes. Guests may attend up to two meetings before becoming members. It's the best way to get to know the network from the inside.

idioma.q: What language are the gatherings held in?
idioma.a: Meetings are in Portuguese. The website has an English version so you can introduce BBN to partners and guests.

treinamentos.a: Yes. Four a year, members only, with practical content on management, sales, finance and leadership.

politica.q: Why is politics off the table?
politica.a: To protect what brings us together. With no party agenda, the discussion stays where it matters to everyone: business, development and relationships.

voluntariado.q: How do I become a volunteer or a leader?
voluntariado.a: By contributing. Members who serve consistently are invited to act as a volunteer and, over time, to lead one front of the network.

form.label: Application
form.title: Send your application
form.intro: Tell us who you are and what you're looking for in the network. A BBN leader will reach out for a conversation — no commitment and no payment at this stage.

hero.label: Events
hero.title: Twice a year, the whole network in one room
hero.intro: BBN gatherings happen in March and September. These are the days when members, guests and partners come together to learn, present their businesses and lock in the connections that carry the year.

hero.label: Partners
hero.title: A network that opens outward
hero.intro: BBN grows alongside those who walk with us: companies, media outlets, venues and Brazilian communities in other states and in Brazil. Partnership here is a real exchange of value, both ways.

hub.label: Relationship hub
hub.title: Four partnership fronts
hub.intro: Each front widens the reach of the network and opens concrete opportunities for our members.

outrosEstados.title: Other states and Brazil
outrosEstados.body: Brazilian groups and leaders in other American states and in Brazil, so a connection made here turns into business there.

parceirosLocais.title: Local partners
parceirosLocais.body: Podcasts, newspapers and influencers who tell the stories of Brazilian entrepreneurs and carry the network to more people.

espacos.title: Event venues
espacos.body: Halls, restaurants, auditoriums and coworking spaces that host our gatherings and gain visibility with the network.

foraDaCaixa.title: Out-of-the-box opportunities
foraDaCaixa.body: Ideas nobody asked for and everybody thanks you for: joint projects, member benefits, new formats for gatherings.

form.label: Proposal
form.title: Propose a partnership
form.intro: Tell us what you have in mind and what you expect from the network. Our leadership reviews every proposal and answers clearly.

hero.label: Leadership
hero.title: The people who hold the network up
hero.intro: In its first year, BBN is led by seven volunteer leaders. They look after the calendar, the quality of the gatherings and, above all, the people who walk through the door.

structure.label: Structure
structure.title: Seven leaders, three pillars
structure.intro: A General Leader is responsible for the direction of the network. Each pillar has two leaders who share planning and execution throughout the year.

motto.body: No BBN leader is there to shine alone. The job of each one is to form the next: delegate for real, teach along the way and make room for whoever comes behind.

cycle.label: Method
cycle.title: The leadership cycle
cycle.intro: Four steps repeated at every event, meeting and training. It's what keeps the network consistent without depending on one person.

planejar.title: Plan
planejar.body: Set the goal, the date and what success means for that gathering — before inviting the first person.

delegar.title: Delegate
delegar.body: Hand out responsibilities with a name and a deadline, giving new leaders real room to learn by doing.

executar.title: Execute
executar.body: Deliver what was agreed, well: start on time, content prepared and every guest properly welcomed.

avaliar.title: Evaluate
avaliar.body: Listen to the participants, name what worked and fix what didn't before the next cycle begins.

hero.label: Contact
hero.title: Let's talk
hero.intro: Want to apply, propose a partnership or simply understand how the network works? Send us a message through the form on this page — someone from the leadership will answer.

hero.label: Privacy
hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.intro: In plain language: what information BBN receives through this site, what we use it for and how you can ask for access, correction or deletion of your data.

privacidade.contactCta: Send a request through the contact form

quemSomos.title: Who we are
body: The Brazilian Business Network (BBN) is a network of Brazilian entrepreneurs based in Connecticut, USA.
BBN is responsible for the information you send through the forms on this site and decides how it is used.

coleta.title: What we collect
body: We only collect what you fill in on the site's forms. Every submission also records the page and the language it was sent from. Here is what each form asks for:
items: Membership application: name, e-mail, phone/WhatsApp, city, company, line of business, website or Instagram and motivation.
Partnership proposal: name, e-mail, phone, company, role, city, partnership type, website or Instagram and message.
Contact: name, e-mail, phone, subject and message.
Meeting visit: name, e-mail, phone/WhatsApp, business or profession and how you heard about BBN.

finalidade.title: What we use your data for
body: We use your information to reply to your message, review membership applications, schedule visits to the monthly meetings and handle partnership proposals.
Your data is never sold and is not used for marketing unrelated to the request you made.

formspree.title: How the forms are sent
body: The site's forms are processed by Formspree, Inc., a company based in the United States. It receives, stores and forwards each submission to BBN, acting only as a service provider.
Formspree has its own privacy policy, which you can read at the link below.

analytics.title: Visit statistics
body: We use Vercel Web Analytics to understand which pages are visited most. It only gathers aggregated page-view statistics.
The tool does not use cookies and does not identify individual visitors.

fotos.title: Event photos
body: Photos from BBN gatherings are published in the site's gallery and hosted on Cloudinary.
If you appear in a photo and would rather it came down, you can ask for it to be removed through the contact form.

compartilhamento.title: Who we share it with
body: Your data only passes through the service providers named in this policy, as far as needed for the site to work.

retencao.title: How long we keep it
body: We keep your information only as long as needed to handle your request or, for members, for as long as the membership relationship lasts.

direitos.title: Your rights
body: You can ask to access, correct or delete the data you sent to BBN.
To do so, use the contact form on the Contact page and tell us what you need. The BBN leadership will take care of your request.
